alerts.description: The combination of dry fuels, gusty northwest winds up to 25 to 35 mph, and minimum relative humidity values near 40 percent will contribute to an elevated risk of fire spread across southern New England. alerts.headline: Small Craft Advisory issued October 29 at 8:38AM EDT until October 29 at 11:00PM EDT by NWS Boston/Norton MA
alerts.areas: Nantucket Sound; Vineyard Sound; Buzzards Bay; Rhode Island Sound
alerts.description: * WHAT...Southwest winds 10 to 15 kt with gusts up to 25 kt and seas around 2 feet expected. * WHERE...In Massachusetts coastal waters, Nantucket Sound, Vineyard Sound and Buzzards Bay. In Rhode Island coastal waters, Rhode Island Sound. * WHEN...From 1 PM this afternoon to 11 PM EDT this evening. * IMPACTS...Conditions will be hazardous to small craft.
alerts.instruction: Inexperienced mariners, especially those operating smaller vessels, should avoid navigating in hazardous conditions.
